shared_elements: human figure in profile with beard and elaborate coiffure/headgear
figure carrying/holding an object in the hand
animal/creature rendered in profile (camel; winged being)
justification: Both depict bearded human figures in strict profile with patterned hair/beard and long fringed garments, holding objects, and both include multi-petalled rosette motifs (as a repeating border band in A, as stylised blossoms on a plant in B), which is a fairly specific shared vocabulary. The scenes themselves differ sharply: A is a horizontal procession frieze of attendants leading a camel between rosette bands, whereas B is a single large winged, kneeling composite being tending a stylised plant, so the compositions and relationships between elements have little in common.
